comment: Smart play (port ADR-094): each CPU's KITCHEN (how far up to the kitchen line it plays, when the rules let it come in), TOGETHER (how closely it keeps level with its partner; a human partner leads) and AIM (shots in 100 it places: dinks, drops, deep to whoever is back, cross-court), 0 to 100. The opponents use their difficulty's; a CPU on a human's side uses partner's. The tuning panel (F2) changes them, saved as settings; DEFAULTS brings these back.
